data.situation:
The following class began online. Lin sat at the same library table with a laptop borrowed from the desk. One window showed her notes; the other showed the lecturer. The timetable combined online discussions with meetings in the classroom. A course email said that the department had enough autonomy to choose its own schedule, so different departments did not all use the same pattern. Dear students,
We are comparing two blended learning models this term: a weekly online discussion with fortnightly classroom meetings, and a classroom course with occasional online tasks. We want to know what helps you learn.
You will also interact with a visiting researcher. Before the meeting, our digital literacy session will cover finding a file, checking its source and sharing it with the right group.
The course team Using other people’s writing
Do not plagiarize a paragraph from a website and submit it as your own. Plagiarism is still plagiarism when the material is online. The course’s guidance on online academic plagiarism shows how to name a source and distinguish a quotation from your own explanation. Ask your tutor if you are unsure. Lin opened the shared file before the researcher joined. A sentence she had copied for discussion was clearly marked as a quotation. Beside it was her own question about the market photograph. When the meeting began, she could find both without closing the other window. The screen was small, but she knew where her material was.

readingBlocks.en: The following class began online. Lin sat at the same library table with a laptop borrowed from the desk. One window showed her notes; the other showed the lecturer. The timetable combined online discussions with meetings in the classroom. A course email said that the department had enough autonomy to choose its own schedule, so different departments did not all use the same pattern.
readingBlocks.zh: 下一堂课在线上开始。林借了服务台的笔记本电脑，坐在图书馆同一张桌旁。一个窗口显示笔记，另一个显示讲师。时间表把线上讨论与教室会面结合起来。课程邮件说，系里有自主决定时间安排的权限，所以不同系并不全部采用同一种方式。

readingBlocks.en:
Dear students,
We are comparing two blended learning models this term: a weekly online discussion with fortnightly classroom meetings, and a classroom course with occasional online tasks. We want to know what helps you learn.
You will also interact with a visiting researcher. Before the meeting, our digital literacy session will cover finding a file, checking its source and sharing it with the right group.
The course team
readingBlocks.zh:
各位同学：
本学期我们比较两种混合式学习模式：每周线上讨论并每两周在教室见面一次，以及以教室上课为主、偶尔穿插线上任务的课程。我们想知道什么能帮助你们学习。
你们还将与一位到访研究者交流。会面前的数字素养课会涉及查找文件、核实来源，以及把文件分享给正确的小组。
课程团队
readingBlocks.title: The course email

readingBlocks.en:
Using other people’s writing
Do not plagiarize a paragraph from a website and submit it as your own. Plagiarism is still plagiarism when the material is online. The course’s guidance on online academic plagiarism shows how to name a source and distinguish a quotation from your own explanation. Ask your tutor if you are unsure.
readingBlocks.zh:
使用他人的文字
不要从网站抄一段文字，作为自己的内容提交。即使材料来自网络，抄袭仍是抄袭。课程关于网络学术抄袭的指南，介绍了怎样标明来源，并把引文与你自己的解释区分开。若有疑问，请问导师。
readingBlocks.title: Beside the keyboard

readingBlocks.en: Lin opened the shared file before the researcher joined. A sentence she had copied for discussion was clearly marked as a quotation. Beside it was her own question about the market photograph. When the meeting began, she could find both without closing the other window. The screen was small, but she knew where her material was.
readingBlocks.zh: 研究者进入会议前，林打开了共享文件。她为讨论复制的一句话，已清楚标作引文。旁边是她自己关于集市照片的问题。会面开始时，她不必关闭另一个窗口，就能找到这两部分。屏幕虽小，她却知道材料在哪里。

glossary.zh: 自行决定事务的权限；自主权
glossary.note: autonomy to do something表示自行作决定的权限；本句是院系决定教学时间表。
glossary.example: The department has autonomy to choose its teaching schedule.
glossary.exampleZh: 系里有自主决定教学安排的权限。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford · autonomy
externalEvidence.findingZh: 组织自行管理和决策的自由；本例院系教学时间安排。

glossary.zh: 结合线上与面对面学习的模式
glossary.note: 这里的blended learning结合线上与面对面学习；models表示不同的安排方式。
glossary.example: The department compares two blended learning models.
glossary.exampleZh: 系里比较两种混合式学习模式。

externalEvidence.label: Cambridge · blended learning
externalEvidence.findingZh: 课堂与计算机技术结合的学习方式；models为本句不同安排，不宣称统一有效性。

glossary.note: interact with + 人，双方交流，而不是仅旁观录像。
glossary.example: Students will interact with a visiting researcher.
glossary.exampleZh: 学生将与一位到访研究者交流。

glossary.zh: 运用及理解数字工具和信息的能力；数字素养
glossary.note: 整块包括使用数字工具及理解信息；不是仅会拼写技术名词。
glossary.example: The digital literacy session covers finding and checking a shared file.
glossary.exampleZh: 数字素养课涉及查找和核实共享文件。

externalEvidence.label: Cambridge · Digital Literacy
externalEvidence.findingZh: 包括使用数字工具、创作及判断网络信息；本句文件查找、来源核实和分享是具体用例。

glossary.zh: 把他人的文字或观点当作自己的；抄袭
glossary.note: 动词，英式也写plagiarise；合法引用与冒充自己的作品不同。
glossary.example: Do not plagiarize a paragraph from a website.
glossary.exampleZh: 不要抄袭网站上的一段文字。

externalEvidence.definition: take without referencing from someone else's writing or speech; of intellectual property

glossary.zh: 将他人的文字或观点冒充自己作品的行为；抄袭
glossary.note: 不可数行为名词；与动词plagiarize分别提供表达入口。
glossary.example: Plagiarism is still plagiarism when the material is online.
glossary.exampleZh: 即使材料来自网络，抄袭仍是抄袭。

externalEvidence.definition: the act of plagiarizing; taking someone's words or ideas as if they were your own

glossary.zh: 使用网络材料进行的学术抄袭
glossary.note: 组合表达限定学术作业与网上材料；不是把所有网络复制都直接当作抄袭。
glossary.example: The guide explains how to avoid online academic plagiarism.
glossary.exampleZh: 指南解释怎样避免网络学术抄袭。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain who can decide the department’s timetable and what teaching arrangements it is comparing.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 说明谁能决定院系的时间表，以及院系正在比较什么教学安排。
acceptableAnswers: The department has autonomy to choose its schedule. It is comparing two blended learning models.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Tell a classmate what they will learn about using files and whom they will talk with.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 告诉同学他们会学到哪些文件使用技能，以及会与谁交流。
acceptableAnswers: The digital literacy session covers finding and checking files. We will also interact with a researcher.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain the difference between a marked quotation and presenting copied material as your own.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 说明标清来源的引文，与将复制材料冒充自己作品的区别。
acceptableAnswers: A marked quotation shows its source. If you plagiarize material and submit it as your own, that is plagiarism.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

transferPrompt.cue: A new online course needs a short notice about copying for assignments. Point students to the appropriate guide.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 一门新网课需要关于作业复制的短通知。指引学生查看合适的指南。
acceptableAnswers: Read the guide to avoiding online academic plagiarism. Name your source and separate quotations from your own explanation.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法
